background: The emperor’s inscription on the hot spring at Lishan. A Tang rubbing from Dunhuang is held in the Bibliothèque nationale de France and catalogued as P.4508.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from a news report. The report identifies the rubbing but does not describe the lost stone.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据新闻报道整理的草稿；报道确认拓本，但未描述已佚原石。

notes: The cited report gives neither the rubbing’s measurements nor its condition.
